sections.title: Philistines and Israel encamp opposite each other
David's family and the forty-day challenge
Jesse sends David to the camp
Saul arms David; David chooses his own weapons
Israel pursues and plunders; David takes trophies

brief.era: Iron Age, period of the judges/early monarchy in ancient Israel
brief.place: Valley of Elah between Socoh and Azekah in Judah; Bethlehem; Jerusalem; Philistine cities of Gath and Ekron
brief.dress: Bronze helmet, coat of mail weighing 5000 shekels, bronze shin armor (Goliath); Saul's clothing and armor tried on by David; shepherd's bag and staff; ordinary Israelite and Philistine military attire
brief.buildings_and_objects: Tents and army camps; wagons; city gates; David's tent; Goliath's spear with weaver's-beam staff and 600-shekel iron head, javelin, sword and sheath; David's sling, five smooth stones from a brook, pouch; parched grain, ten loaves, ten cheeses
depiction_rules: Goliath is a giant, six cubits and a span tall
Do not depict Yahweh or God as a human figure; refer to divine action only through effects or absence of image
David is a youth, ruddy, with a good-looking face
Goliath falls face-down after the stone strikes his forehead; David cuts off his head with Goliath's own sword
Philistines flee after their champion dies
Do not show David wearing Saul's armor in the final confrontation; he removes it
